dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, what is your group's project about?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt ɪz jʊr ˈɡruːps ˈprɑːdʒɛkt əˈbaʊt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's about climate change in Thailand. We think floods in Bangkok are likely to get worse.
dialogue.reading: ɪts əˈbaʊt ˈklaɪmət ˌtʃeɪndʒ ɪn ˈtaɪlænd. wiː ˈθɪŋk ˈflʌdz ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk ər ˈlaɪkli tə ˈɡɛt ˈwɜːrs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Global warming is making the sea level rise, and Bangkok is very close to the sea.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡloʊbəl ˈwɔːrmɪŋ ɪz ˈmeɪkɪŋ ðə ˈsiː ˌlɛvəl ˈraɪz, ənd ˈbæŋkɑːk ɪz ˈvɛri ˈkloʊz tə ðə ˈsiː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I see. What about farmers? Are they likely to have problems, too?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsiː. ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈfɑːrmərz? ər ðeɪ ˈlaɪkli tə ˈhæv ˈprɑːbləmz, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. There are likely to be more droughts, so some farmers might lose their harvest.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðɛr ər ˈlaɪkli tə bi ˈmɔːr ˈdraʊts, soʊ sʌm ˈfɑːrmərz maɪt ˈluːz ðɛr ˈhɑːrvɪst.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's worrying. Emma, what about Canada?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈwɜːriɪŋ. ˈɛmə, ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈkænədə?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: The snow melts earlier every spring, and our summers are getting hotter.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈsnoʊ ˈmɛlts ˈɜːrliər ˈɛvri ˈsprɪŋ, ənd aʊr ˈsʌmərz ər ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈhɑːtər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So, is the weather likely to get more extreme?
dialogue.reading: ˈsoʊ, ɪz ðə ˈwɛðər ˈlaɪkli tə ˈɡɛt ˈmɔːr ɪkˈstriːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I think so. But if we do something now, the worst problems are unlikely to happen.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈθɪŋk ˈsoʊ. bʌt ɪf wiː ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈnaʊ, ðə ˈwɜːrst ˈprɑːbləmz ər ʌnˈlaɪkli tə ˈhæpən.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good. I look forward to hearing more on Friday.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. aɪ ˈlʊk ˈfɔːrwərd tə ˈhɪrɪŋ ˈmɔːr ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ.
